# Dittle

> Notes that keep track. Write runs, dinners, trips and budgets as plain notes. Dittle spots the numbers and dates, files them into tables, does the maths, and when a value changes in one note it updates every other note that uses it. Private, instant, works offline.

Dittle uses Firebase AI Logic in hybrid mode. Gemini Nano on the user's device (Chrome's Prompt API) spots values as you type, names columns, spots formulas and writes requests, with Gemini Flash-Lite in the cloud when the device has no model. Describing values, filing them into collections, linking them across notes and sorting the home box go to the cloud first, with Nano taking over offline. It was built for #BuildHybridAI 2026.
